description: Create a Shared Memory In/Out TOP/CHOP for zero-copy IPC with another app on the same host (Notch, Unity, Unreal, custom tools). Pick direction ('in' to receive, 'out' to publish), kind (TOP for pixel buffers, CHOP for numeric channels), and a shmName that the peer must match exactly. After creating an Out variant, wire the producer TOP/CHOP into it with connect_nodes. When format.header=false the peer reads a raw headerless buffer — sizes must agree exactly or frames will garble. Some (direction, kind) combos are platform/build-dependent; the tool returns a friendly fatal if the optype isn't available.

direction.description: 'in' = receive from an external app; 'out' = publish to an external app.

format.description: Optional format hints. Unknown / unsupported pars on this build become warnings.

header.description: Include the TD header block in the segment (`header` par). When false, the peer reads a raw headerless buffer of exact size — easy to garble.

numChannels.description: (CHOP, out) channel count when the operator wants it pinned.

pixelFormat.description: (TOP) pixel format — best-effort mapping to the operator's menu.

kind.description: TOP = pixel buffer (RGBA frames); CHOP = numeric channels (control / audio-rate).

name.description: Operator name; auto-generated when omitted (e.g. shm_in / shm_out).

parent.description: COMP path to create the operator in.

shmName.description: Shared-memory segment name. Must match exactly on both sides. Two TDs using the same name will collide.

name: create_shared_memory_bridge
title: Create Shared Memory bridge
